description: Funds transfer where a TransferPolicy domain service owns the daily-limit rule that spans two Account aggregates and the transfer history; the Account raises TransferSent itself, and a handler credits the destination or returns the funds

hard.note: Business rules in a service class look like an anemic model or logic in an application service, but the rule spans two aggregates, so a domain service legitimately owns it, and the entities keep their own invariants

_calibration.note: Clean counterpart to dm-logic-in-ui; up to two suggestions allowed, since the agent reasonably proposes design alternatives such as moving the limit check into the aggregate. Stress run 20261117T112433Z failed every arm: the account let its balance and limit currencies differ, the application service built the transfer event, and a failed credit had no refund path; all three fixed
